new_source_candidates.documented_capability: Return proportions rather than frequencies for distinct rows.
new_source_candidates.core_method: 分类观测频数统计与归一化
new_source_candidates.target_invalid_reason: A004 accepts named numeric component weights; this callable counts repeated observations instead of normalizing supplied component amounts.

new_source_candidates.documented_capability: Compute a histogram and optionally return probability density values.
new_source_candidates.core_method: 直方图频数与密度归一化
new_source_candidates.target_invalid_reason: The output is bin density over observations and is not a named component-weight mapping divided by its sum.

new_source_candidates.documented_capability: Scale each feature independently to a specified range.
new_source_candidates.core_method: 特征最小最大区间缩放
new_source_candidates.main_input: 组成样本矩阵、基准范围和裁剪选项
new_source_candidates.main_output: 区间缩放组成、最小值与范围偏差
new_source_candidates.target_invalid_reason: Featurewise min-max scaling across samples does not produce a unit-sum composition for one supplied component vector.

new_source_candidates.documented_capability: Standardize values relative to their arithmetic mean and standard deviation.
new_source_candidates.core_method: 算术均值与标准差Z分数变换
new_source_candidates.main_input: 组成、基准轴、自由度和缺失值策略
new_source_candidates.main_output: 标准化组成、均值和标准差偏差
new_source_candidates.target_invalid_reason: Z-scores are centered around zero and may be negative; they are not nonnegative unit-sum fractions.

new_source_candidates.documented_capability: Standardize strictly positive values relative to geometric mean and geometric standard deviation.
new_source_candidates.core_method: 几何均值与几何标准差Z分数变换
new_source_candidates.main_input: 正值组成、基准轴、自由度和缺失值策略
new_source_candidates.main_output: 几何标准化组成、均值和标准差偏差
new_source_candidates.target_invalid_reason: Geometric Z-scores are log-standardized coordinates rather than nonnegative unit-sum fractions.

new_source_candidates.documented_capability: Transform a strictly positive composition into centered log-ratio coordinates whose sum is zero.
new_source_candidates.core_method: 成分中心对数比变换与Aitchison几何映射
new_source_candidates.main_input: 组成、基准轴和正值校验
new_source_candidates.main_output: 中心对数比组成、几何均值偏差
new_source_candidates.target_invalid_reason: CLR returns real-space log-ratio coordinates summing to zero, not the original components rescaled to sum to one.

new_source_candidates.documented_capability: Transform a composition into additive log-ratio coordinates relative to one reference component.
new_source_candidates.core_method: 成分加性对数比变换与参考组分映射
new_source_candidates.main_input: 组成、基准轴、参考组分和正值校验
new_source_candidates.main_output: 加性对数比组成、参考分量偏差
new_source_candidates.target_invalid_reason: ALR drops one dimension and returns log ratios relative to a reference component, not unit-sum fractions.

mandatory_independence_review_groups.required_decision: prove arithmetic and geometric standard scores are independently reportable scientific tools rather than parameter variants
prove CLR and ALR are independently reportable transforms rather than aliases or parameter variants
